title: Savannah River throughput hold: three-facility and SWPF-only periods are not one series
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE's 2024 record reports more than 15 million gallons processed since 2008 across three facilities and about 7.5 million by SWPF in its first three years; the 2026 record reports more than 10.6 million gallons processed by SWPF since 2022. Denominator: Two overlapping but non-identical SRS salt-waste reporting universes and start dates.
